response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the medieval kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now faded and worn. The king, KING ARIN, sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

KING ARIN
(nodding)
Yes. We will incorporate the latest trends from the East, the most advanced technologies from the North. We will make our kingdom the envy of all the land.

ADVISOR 2
(alarmed)
But, Your Majesty, what of our traditional ways? Our honor, our chivalry?

KING ARIN
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are just relics of the past. We must adapt, evolve. (he gestures to a nearby servant) Bring me the latest designs from the East.

The servant scurries off, returning with a stack of papers and a strange, glowing rectangle.

KING ARIN
(excitedly)
Ah, yes! This is it! This is the future!

The advisors exchange worried glances as King Arin begins to study the designs, his eyes widening with excitement.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE - DAY

King Arin's advisors are gathered around a large table, surrounded by strange, futuristic contraptions and strange, glowing orbs.

ADVISOR 1
(whispering)
What is this, Your Majesty? Some sort of... ritual?

KING ARIN
(laughing)
No, no, my friends. This is the future. We will harness the power of... (he consults a small, glowing rectangle)...Vaporwave.

The advisors look at each other in confusion as King Arin begins to manipulate the glowing orbs, creating a strange, pulsating light show.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The once-majestic stone walls now bear strange, futuristic designs, the flags bearing the royal crest now replaced with glowing, neon-colored stripes. The king's advisors are dressed in strange, futuristic attire, their faces painted with intricate, swirling patterns.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
Behold! Our kingdom, reborn!

The advisors look at each other, unsure of what to make of the strange new world they find themselves in.

ADVISOR 2
(whispering)
I think we've made a mistake, Your Majesty.

KING ARIN
(laughing)
Nonsense! This is the future! We will be the envy of all the land!

The camera pans out, showing the kingdom in all its strange, futuristic glory. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now faded and worn.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
